changelog: DIAGNOSTIC (1 GB Fire Stick auto-shutdown — Step 2): App now captures post-mortem exit reasons (native SIGSEGV crashes, kernel OOM-kills, signal kills) via Android's first-party ApplicationExitInfo API. Previously the app's crash handler could only see Java exceptions, which is why the AFTSS / AFTKM silent-shutdown bug was invisible to support. Each abnormal exit now uploads with reason (CRASH_NATIVE / LOW_MEMORY / SIGNALED), POSIX signal (SIGSEGV / SIGABRT / SIGBUS), PSS / RSS memory footprint at moment of death, and the OS-attached native tombstone trace. Visible in the admin Crash Monitor under the new fuchsia 'Exit-info' filter. Zero behaviour change for the user — diagnostic-only.

DIAGNOSTIC: Every existing crash / ANR report now carries a memory snapshot (memoryClass, isLowRamDevice, availMem, lowMemThreshold) so support can correlate freezes with low-memory state at a glance.
FIX (v519): Memory-trimmed Pro mode for 1 GB Fire Sticks (RGB_565 posters, tighter Coil cache).
DIAGNOSTIC (v518): Crash reports tagged with Xtream username for per-customer lookup.
FIX (v517): Navigation Compose bump for BACK-button crash.
FIX (v516): 4 Movie/Series crashes on weak Fire Sticks.
FIX (v515): 'Switch to Lite Mode' takes effect instantly.
FIX (v514): Permanent ANR fix via Moshi codegen.
